adds.title: 2023 religious refusal bill - West Virginia Legislature / Governor
adds.summary: On February 27-28, 2023 the West Virginia House and Senate passed House Bill 3042, a Religious Freedom Restoration Act sent to Governor Jim Justice for signature, which provides that a person or corporation claiming a state or local law or government policy burdens religious belief may claim exemption from compliance, thereby permitting denial of business service, housing, and government service based on sexual orientation or gender identity affecting trans visitors.

adds.title: Ordinance nullification bill - West Virginia Senate
adds.summary: On March 26, 2025, the West Virginia Senate approved a bill to nullify local nondiscrimination ordinances, eliminating local-level protections against discrimination relevant to transgender visitors.
